title: Pin First, Take Later
setup: Black's rook on f5 has strayed onto the same diagonal as its king, with one empty square between them.
hint: Which of your pieces can attack that rook and freeze it in the same breath? Look for the line to d7.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on **f5**, the empty square e6 and the king on **d7** sit on one diagonal. {{Bg4}} attacks the rook along it, and the pin makes moving the rook illegal. Nothing guards f5, so the rook is yours next move.
